source: Derived from live ARTHHRMS code inspection. No runtime files were modified.

services.name: DB authenticated persistence facade

defaultFlags: module table flags false until activated

riskAreas.evidence: Synchronous UI facade with authenticated, tenant-scoped Supabase projection persistence.
riskAreas.impact: A regression in DB migrate/normalize affects every page.

riskAreas.evidence: 307842 bytes, 187 DB references, many modules and inline handlers.
riskAreas.impact: High chance of accidental coupling and hard-to-test UI behavior.

riskAreas.evidence: Production invite delivery uses the derived Edge Function endpoint and auth_user_id mapping. authCallbackService owns callback exchange, authInviteService owns invite activation, and passwordRecoveryService owns recovery state.
riskAreas.impact: Misconfiguration blocks onboarding or creates identity-linking risk.

riskAreas.evidence: payrollService depends on employee, attendance, leave, expense, workflow, deployment safety, monitoring.
riskAreas.impact: Cross-module errors can affect salary trust.

riskAreas.evidence: All notification, audit, pending, escalation paths converge here.
riskAreas.impact: A routing bug affects dashboards, pressure widgets, audit trail, and monitoring.

riskAreas.evidence: importService is 50589 bytes and touches employee, attendance, leave, payroll, workflow, staging, migration readiness.
riskAreas.impact: Bad imports can corrupt identity, attendance, and payroll if gates are bypassed.

riskAreas.evidence: RLS SQL exists for core tables, but runtime flags default to fallback/local until Supabase verification.
riskAreas.impact: Policy mistakes can create visibility leaks after live activation.

riskAreas.evidence: workflowEngine reports incidents; operationsMonitoringService reads workflow state and hooks events.
riskAreas.impact: Error loops or duplicate incidents are possible if a monitored path fails loudly.

areas: manual QA flows for auth, attendance, leave, expense, payroll, imports, notifications, role access, RLS, fallback
RLS visibility assertions after SQL activation

bottlenecks.description: db.js remains the central runtime persistence and compatibility surface for all role pages.
bottlenecks.evidence: All inspected pages load db.js and most still call DB directly.

bottlenecks.description: HR, employee, super admin, admin, and manager dashboards contain large inline script blocks and module logic.
bottlenecks.evidence: hr-dashboard.html 307842 bytes, employee-portal.html 132938 bytes, super-admin.html 94878 bytes.

bottlenecks.description: Workflow, notification, audit, pending action, and escalation behavior converge into workflowEngine.
bottlenecks.evidence: workflowEngine defines all workflow events and routing rules.

bottlenecks.description: Payroll calculations depend on employee, attendance, leave, expense, deployment safety, workflow, and monitoring.
bottlenecks.evidence: payrollService references employeeService, attendanceService, leaveService, expenseService, deploymentSafetyService, workflowEngine, operationsMonitoringService.

bottlenecks.description: Import services can touch employee, attendance, leave, payroll, staging, migration readiness, workflow, and monitoring paths.
bottlenecks.evidence: importService and importStagingService references and SQL staging tables.

bottlenecks.description: notificationService delegates to workflowEngine; workflowEngine can reference notificationService; workflowEngine also reports to operationsMonitoringService while monitoring reads workflow health.
bottlenecks.evidence: Detected circular dependencies in service references.

runtimeClassification.reason: Protected routes require validated Supabase Auth sessions.
Employee CRUD persists through authenticated domain projections and the employee adapter.
Attendance CRUD persists through authenticated domain projections and the attendance adapter.
Leave CRUD persists through authenticated domain projections and the leave adapter.
Expense CRUD persists through authenticated tenant-scoped projections.
Payroll CRUD persists through authenticated domain projections and payroll tables.
storageService is gated by USE_SUPABASE_STORAGE and storage policies exist.
importService has USE_SUPABASE_IMPORTS path, but current staging is local-first.
Workflow, notification, and audit records use authenticated tenant-scoped projections.
SQL exists, but platformGovernanceService reads/writes DB platformGovernance.
QA validation uses local services and DB run logs.
Service generates isolated in-memory/local test data and persists run history locally.
Incidents, metrics, and service errors use authenticated governance projections.
jobOpenings and jobApplications are DB collections only.
onboarding, resignation, verification, helpdesk, collections are DB collections only.
performanceGoals, appraisals, reviewCycles are DB collections only.

strongestAreas: Clear service wrappers exist for employees, attendance, leave, expense, payroll, auth, imports, governance, testing, monitoring.
SQL foundation covers core live tables, staging tables, auth invitations, governance, workflow, audit, RLS, and storage policies.
Feature flags and environment modes allow controlled local/hybrid/live activation.
Import pipeline uses staging and rollback concepts instead of direct raw ingest.
QA and Enterprise Test Lab services include isolation checks and workflow simulations.
Operations Monitoring captures incidents, service errors, performance metrics, and recovery actions.
biggestBottlenecks: db.js and hr-dashboard.html are very large central surfaces.
Many dashboards still call DB directly instead of only service facades.
Workflow and notification paths are central and partly cyclic.
Payroll and import paths have broad cross-module dependency fan-in/fan-out.
Supabase SQL and RLS are prepared, but live activation remains controlled by flags and requires external execution/verification.
futureHardeningRecommendations: Split hr-dashboard.html and employee-portal.html into module-specific scripts without changing behavior.
Move direct DB calls behind service methods module by module.
Add automated browser smoke tests for every role dashboard and bell/pending widget.
Run SQL execution order in a Supabase staging branch and record live health results in Platform Control Center.
Add contract tests for workflowEngine routes and notification/audit side effects.
Add payroll calculation golden tests and import rollback tests before production payroll use.
Make operationsMonitoringService resilient to recursive incident creation.
